name: craig-email
description: Craig's preferred email voice, formatting and safe sending workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Write and send email in Craig's style.
interface.longDescription: Draft, review, reply to, forward and send email using Craig's preferred voice, Trebuchet MS formatting, sign-off and explicit sending boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Use $write-craig-email to draft a concise email in my preferred style.
Use $write-craig-email to reply to this email in my preferred style.
Use $write-craig-email to review this draft and send it only after I explicitly approve it.
